biggest_catch: uSell is a marketplace to buyers, not the buyer: your offer comes from its buyer network, any of whom can revise it after receipt, and payment only starts within five business days after that.
catches: The buyer can revise the offer if the device does not match your description; quotes can change.
Value varies by device, condition, and demand; offers come from a buyer network, not uSell itself.
Five business days is the initiation window - checks take longer to arrive than PayPal.
No selling fee and free tracked shipping, but the offer depends on third-party buyers.
Resale catch-all: value varies by condition and demand; quotes and market prices can change; fees or shipping can reduce your actual proceeds.

payout_quote: Get an offer from our buyer network, ship free with tracked shipping, and receive PayPal or check payment initiated within five business days after receipt - with no selling fee.

repeatable.cadence: You can do this once per device you own - it is bounded by the electronics you already have, not a daily income stream.

s1.note: No selling fee; shipping free and tracked.

s4.note: Offer is free with no obligation.

s6.note: Revised offers on condition mismatch - disclosed in terms.

steps: Describe your device to get a buyer-network offer
Accept the offer and ship free with the tracked prepaid label
uSell's buyer receives and checks the device
PayPal or check payment initiated within five business days after receipt
timing: PayPal/check payment initiated within five business days after the buyer receives the device.
who_pays: A buyer in uSell's buyer network - uSell is a marketplace to third-party buyers, not the buyer itself. Payment comes via uSell after the buyer receives your device.
who_qualifies: You must be 18+, in the US, and own the device. Only eligible electronics are accepted.
work_available: Yes - the buyer-network marketplace was live on usell.com as of 2026-09-23. Your offer depends on which buyers bid; re-quote if your first offer is low, since bids differ by buyer.
what_gets_accepted: The buyer's offer only holds if your device matches your description on receipt - any buyer can revise it downward after checking the device.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No selling fee and free tracked shipping. Your unpaid time is describing the device, shipping, and waiting up to five business days after receipt for payment to be initiated.
when_cash_arrives: Real cash - PayPal or check, initiated within five business days after the buyer receives your device. PayPal arrives much faster than a mailed check.
